data.StockDefs: Western Atlantic stock, Gulf of Mexico spawning component.
Atlantic Ocean and adjacent seas, including the Mediterranean and the Black Sea.
data.StockDefsGeneral: Widely distributed across the temperate North Atlantic.
data.Resilience: Very low, minimum population doubling time more than 14 years
data.ResilienceRemark: Assuming a low fecundity-at-age and late maturity (Ref. 32988).
data.Comments: Heavily targeted by longline and purse seine fisheries.
